bertiefletching.tank.fill: Use a potion or Shift-click to fill
bertiefletching.part.0.resplendent: +50% speed, Primordial Fire for 10s, launches the target 10 blocks.
bertiefletching.part.0.sun: +100% speed, no gravity, Glowing, burn for 20s, +10 fire damage.
bertiefletching.part.1.fishing: Pulls the target toward the shooter.
bertiefletching.part.1.chain: Binds up to 6 nearby targets for 5s.
bertiefletching.part.1.ender: Homing, 3 ricochets, phase through blocks and shields.
bertiefletching.part.2.amethyst: +1 damage; breaks through leaves and glass.
bertiefletching.part.2.abyssal: +4 damage, +4 damage in water or rain. Unaffected by water.
bertiefletching.part.2.moonstone: +5 damage, +3 damage at night, 10% armor piercing.
bertiefletching.part.2.reinforced_echo: +10 damage, 30% armor piercing; fires a sonic boom at the closest other target.
bertiefletching.part.2.heavy: +1 damage per block of arrow descent.
bertiefletching.part.2.divine: Executes targets below 30% HP and teleports their loot to the player.
bertiefletching.part.2.eldritch: Deals AoE damage within 6 blocks of the arrow path, executes below 30% HP and teleports loot to the player.
bertiefletching.part.3.slime: Bounces off blocks up to 3 times.
bertiefletching.part.3.honey: Slows targets and temporarily turns nearby blocks into honey.
bertiefletching.part.3.pearl: Teleports the shooter to the impact location.
bertiefletching.part.3.wind: Launches target and nearby enemies 7 blocks.
bertiefletching.part.3.torch: Lights the arrow path and places a torch on impact.
death.attack.bertie_arrow: %1$s was struck by an enhanced arrow
